Mahodadhi
of the Prābhākara school an. a contemporary of Śālikanātha; ref. to in C. Candrikā on Prabodhacandrodaya (II. 3); said to have been refuted by his contemporary Mahāvrata; ref. to also by Bhavanātha Bhaṭṭa in Nayaviveka; hence assigned to 700-770 A. D. But some assign the period between 680 an. 725 A. D.; this work embodies the views of Prābhākara school; it was available to Bhavanātha an. Kṛṣṇamiśra. He is said to be the a. of a Nibandhana work. [Page19-318a]
See Tattvabindu, Intro. p.. 50-51; See Cintāmaṇi's article in the JOR. Vol. II. 62 ff.
